arabic_html:
قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ
لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌۭ ۗ
وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ
إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍۢ ۞
translation: Say, O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account.
explanation_html: Every good deed is weighed — except one. Ibn Kathīr, citing al-Awzāʿī: the patient person's reward is not weighed or measured at all; it is given without limit.
